name: Narusawa Minako
source:
She is a second-year student at Harusaki Academy.
Among the dormitory members, many of whom cannot cook or do household chores, she has excellent housekeeping skills and is very family oriented.
She is kind and gentle to everyone and has a relaxed atmosphere.
Although she has a somewhat natural side, she has a strong core and is a good-natured person.
Her hobbies include cooking and fortune-telling, just like a girl. She loves sweets, but is very concerned about her weight these days.

"Oh, I should get ready for dinner soon."
